owner_authorization: User agreed to execute V2; Actions allowed after direct download failure; no 2026/trading/production.
decision_grid: one minute, half-session minute31..105; same decision clock for B0/B1/B2
label: V1 operational first tail event retained: abs minute log return >30bp AND >4x preceding30min RMS, floor1bp, preceding30 known event-free minutes
target: event close at t+2..t+15; label t+1 competing imminent event separately; all-window safety label retained; no silent imminent exclusion
minimum_lead: one minute before earliest possible event-minute onset; not merely before event close
primary_gap_contract: fresh as-of endpoints age<=3s, no interpolation; discard return crossing source gap>15s. This is an endpoint-grid measurement, NOT an uninterrupted3s path.
same_second: source rows preserved; stable last row_index for as-of endpoint explicitly; same-second moves make path timing unknown
B0: sealed V1 baseline feature structure; refit to actionable target and same support as B1/B2; NOT the V1 fitted estimator
B2_extra: four log Haar energies at physical30/60/120/240s, each trailing5m smooth, residualized on B1 training only; retain all scales separately
estimation: StandardScaler + ridge(alpha=1) residualization; StandardScaler + logistic(C=1, no class weights, max_iter=2000). Fit2021/22 only. No hyperparameter search.
thresholds: 2023 score quantiles from all eligible decisions, no calibration outcomes; also evaluation-only exact ranking quotas; do not confuse these.
paired_inference: five-trading-day moving-block bootstrap,1000 draws,seed20260907; B2-minus-B1 Clean actionable risk conditional on fixed fitted models/quota; all index-years reported
phases: all15 minute phases reported; no best-phase selection

random_reference.method: constrained whole-session alarm template assignment within afternoon and train-defined minute31 logRV30 tertiles; random-cost Hungarian assignment; identity allowed
random_reference.limitation: coarse conditioning; not a uniform exact permutation-test p-value

ledger: all known minute first events >=minute33 plus3 controls each, same index/year/half-session/minute, nearest logRV30/logRV480; event-free surrounding intervals. Hindsight only, never classifier training or population incidence estimation.
path_descriptors: raw observation path -10m..+5m around event close; freshness and maxgap; source-vs-official return; observed range lower bound; top3 abs increment share/ER only complete3s paths without same-second extras;20/80pct progress descriptive not true onset
unknown_policy: no fill of absent/repair prices. B0/B1/B2 share decision support. Report every source/year support and event loss; label Unknown is not Clean.
scientific_status: exploratory sequential evaluation on consumed history; neither causality nor deployment acceptance
limits: 15s forecast is primary;30/60 are measurement audit only
no order flow or intensity inferred from snapshot row counts
